Four Detained After Video of Girl's Harassment Surfaces in Bihar

Four individuals have been detained following the emergence of a video depicting the alleged harassment of a girl in Bihar. The incident, which occurred in Samastipur district, has drawn comparisons to a previous case in Jamui. Reports indicate that the girl was groped and harassed in public. The emergence of the video has sparked outrage and discussions about women's safety in the state, with some outlets noting that molestation cases have been reported from two other Bihar districts following the Jamui incident.
